contrastAnchors: Apply these defaults to new repositories. Preserve existing compatible tooling and equivalent declared checks in established projects; do not overwrite their AGENTS or workflows wholesale. Bootstrap engine selection is owned by [bootstrap-and-structure.md](bootstrap-and-structure.md). Align CI Node and pnpm with the runtime pins and lockfile. The template runs Node 24 and reads the root `package.json` field `packageManager`. Keep one source for the pnpm version. Generate the lockfile with the authorized install. A frozen CI install requires the matching lockfile in the checked-out revision. Adapt branch filters and monorepo working directory/cache lockfile location to the actual repo.

Apply these defaults to new repositories. Preserve existing compatible tooling and equivalent declared checks in established projects; do not overwrite their AGENTS or workflows wholesale. Bootstrap engine selection is owned by [bootstrap-and-structure.md](bootstrap-and-structure.md). Align CI Node and pnpm with the runtime pins and lockfile. The template runs Node 24 and reads the root `package.json` field `packageManager`. For a new scaffold, set it to the exact pnpm used to create the lockfile (for example, `pnpm@10.28.2`). If the project keeps that field unset, supply the selected version in the `pnpm/action-setup` input `with.version`. Generate the lockfile with the authorized install. A frozen CI install requires the matching lockfile in the checked-out revision. Adapt branch filters and monorepo working directory/cache lockfile location to the actual repo.
